source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("Rural council nominations: Newtownards")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Nominations and unopposed returns read on the block images of the Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 (article BNL19520521.2.237); Comber votes from the Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1952, p. 5.

note: Triennial election of the eighteen electoral divisions of Newtownards (North Down) rural district, one member each. Comber was the only contested division (three candidates), polled Thursday 5 June 1952; fifteen members were returned unopposed and in Greyabbey and Kircubbin, where no one was nominated, the retiring councillors were declared re-elected. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
